text:
sophia (partnerships): FYI — new cloud marketplace reseller goes live in APAC next Wed. They committed to a 30-day pilot: ~120k GPU-hours across inference and embedding workloads. They expect a 50% ramp in week 1. Request: can we provision/reserve capacity and confirm regional constraints?

kevin (capacity): 120k GPU-hours / 30d ~= 4k GPU-hours/day. With 24h day that's ~167 concurrent GPU-hours => roughly 170 A10G-equivalent GPUs steady. With 50% ramp front-loaded, peak might be ~250 GPUs. Need to map to our instance types & reserved pools.

josh (infra): APAC region note — ap-southeast1 has limited reserved inventory. Current long-term reserved A10G = 80, spot/backfill ~60 but spot reliability in region is sketchy during peak hours. Cross-region fallback will add egress costs and latency.

alen (sre): We should do a canary pool + staged rollover. Plan: carve out a 40-GPU canary (prewarmed), then ramp to 120 reserved, burst to 250 via quota-burst to other regions if needed. Health checks: warm-up latency tests, KV cache priming. Also suggest 2m drain window on node rotations.

kevin (capacity): Proposed reservation YAML for capacity team to create (quick sketch):
```
reservation: marketplace-reseller-apac-pilot
region: ap-southeast1
reserved_gpus: 120
burst_policy:
  allowed_regions: [ap-southeast1, ap-east1, us-west1]
  max_cross_region_pct: 30
start: 2026-04-01
end: 2026-04-30
```
This will buy us baseline predictability.

josh (infra): +networking warning: partner will egress embeddings to their analytics endpoint in SG. Need to confirm egress bandwidth and NAT gateway capacity — otherwise we risk per-node network saturation. Suggest adding an egress VPC endpoint and enable rate-limited NAT IPs.

marta (sales): Partner expects weekly usage reports and a hard SLA for pilot. If we short them due to capacity, they'll escalate to the marketplace ops team. Can we guarantee at least 95% of requested GPU-hours?

kevin (capacity): Realistic guarantee: with 120 reserved + 30% burst to other regions we can target ~95% during normal traffic. During convoys/marketplace promos (Fri/Sat in APAC) risk rises. Recommend contractual caveat and surge pricing.

alen (sre): Ops runbook items:
- Prewarm canary pool 24h before launch
- Smoke test: 500 concurrent short-seq requests for 30m
- KV/prefix cache priming script (we'll run via job)
- Autoscaler thresholds: scale-down delay 5m, scale-up aggressive (10s) for stepups
- Fallback policy: route to dedicated us-west pool if latency >250ms for >2m

sophia (partnerships): Sounds good. Can you owners please ack and push reservation request by EOD today? Partner onboarding kickoff is TOMORROW.

kevin (capacity): ACK. I will open CR with reservations team and attach cost delta estimates.

josh (infra): ACK. I'll validate NAT & egress dims and open a network ticket for the VPC endpoint.

alen (sre): ACK. I'll prepare the canary job + health checks and share runbook.

deploy-bot: capacity-reservation created (CR-2209) by kevin (capacity) :white_check_mark:

marta (sales): Thanks team. I'll tell partner we have a reservation in flight and share the runbook timeline. :thumbsup:

sophia (partnerships): One more ask — can we attach a quick cost estimate for the pilot (reserved + expected cross-region egress)? Partner wants to evaluate unit economics before kickoff.

kevin (capacity): Will post numbers in CR-2209 in ~2h. Quick ballpark: reserved 120 A10G ~ $X/day, burst egress & spot variability add ~20-35% variable cost. I'll break down per-GPU-hour and per-embedding-unit in the CR.

alen (sre): If we need to shave cost while preserving latency, consider recommending int8 quantized variants for embedding jobs and 8k token limit routes for generative. Saves GPU-hours by ~18-25% in our perf tests.

sophia (partnerships): Perfect. keep this thread updated. I'll loop in marketplace ops if anything changes.
